objective: Recommend whether Juno should open production onboarding for real child and family data.

context_sources.summary: Current production onboarding and child-data controls require live verification.
context_sources.relevance_to_decision: Control effectiveness determines whether regulated data may enter production.

cognitive_needs.why_selected: A safe decision depends on how a control failure could expose data.
cognitive_needs.uncertainty_reduced: Which control path can cause unauthorized data access.

cognitive_needs.why_selected: Authentication, tenancy, operations, and support controls interact.
cognitive_needs.uncertainty_reduced: Whether system interactions create an exposure not visible in one component.

domain_needs.why_selected: Production access controls and threat paths are material.
domain_needs.uncertainty_reduced: Whether confidentiality and integrity controls are effective.

domain_needs.why_selected: The decision concerns child and family personal data.
domain_needs.uncertainty_reduced: Whether collection, access, transmission, and retention are bounded.

domain_needs.why_selected: Safeguarding and institutional workflows constrain acceptable operation.
domain_needs.uncertainty_reduced: Whether education-specific duties and child impact are covered.

domain_needs.why_selected: Live deployment identity and control implementation require technical proof.
domain_needs.uncertainty_reduced: Whether tested controls match production code and configuration.

epistemic_register.statement: Production control evidence exists but requires freshness verification.
A prior controlled demo does not by itself prove onboarding readiness.

uncertainty_register: Live authorization, provisioning, retention, and operational rollback evidence are incomplete.
